paite: Huan huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David in Philistia mite sual in azou hi. Huchi in David in Philistia mite khut a pan Metheg-ammah alaksak hi.
heading: David Vualzohnate / (1 Kro 18.1-17)

paite: Moab mite asual a, lei a lumsak in khau in ateh a; vual nih athat a, vual khat bel ahinghawi hi. Huchi in Moab mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, thilpiakte ahon tawi uhi.
David in Euphrates Luipi a, gam la nawn dia hoh in Zobah kumpipa Rehob tapa Hadadezer leng athat hi.
Huchi in David in asakol tungtuangmi sangkhat-le-zasagih leh lei sepaih singnih amatsak hi. Huchi in kangtalai kai ding zakhat chih louh sakol tengteng athagui uh asattansak hi.
Damaskas a Siria mite Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh dia kuante David in Siria mite lak a mi singnih-le-sangnih athat hi.
Huchi in David in Siria gam a Damaskas ah sepaih akoih hi. Siria mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah aliau uhi. TOUPA'N ahohna peuh ah David avualzousak zel hi.
David in Hadadezer pawlte dangka-eng lumte alaksak a, Jerusalem ah apaipih hi.
Hadadezer khopite Betah leh Berothai a pan David in dal tampi ala hi.
Hamath kumpipa Toi in Hadadezer sepaih tengteng David in azou chih azak in,

Hadadezer asual a, azou chih azak in chibai buk ding leh vualzawl ding in Toi in David kiang ah atapa Joram asawl a; David in lah Hadadezer dou in ana that khinta hi. Huchi in Joram in dangka belte, dangka-eng belte leh dal belte ahon tawi hi.
Huaite leh namdang azoh tengteng a pan alak dangka leh dangka-eng kumpipa David in TOUPA kiang ah alan hi:
Siriate, Moabte, Ammon suante, Philistiate, Amalekte leh Zobah kumpipa Rehob tapa Hadadezer a kipan agallakte.
David in Chi Phaizang ah Siria mi singkhat-le-sanggiat ava that a, apailam in aminthangta hi.
Edom ah sepaih akoih a; Edom gam teng ah sepaih akoih hi. Huchi in Edom mi tengteng David sikha ahong hita uh. Huchi in TOUPA'N David apaina peuh ah avualzousak hi.
Huchi in David in Israel mi tengteng tung ah vai ahawm a; David in ami tengteng tung ah diktattak in vai ahawm hi.
Zeruiah tapa Joab sepaih heutupen ahi. Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat bel tanchin gelhpa ahi.
Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Ahimelek siampute ahi ua; Seraiah bel laigelhmi ahi.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi ua, David tapate bel vaihawmtu liante ahi uh.
